info.name: Retrieve an Animated Image from a Video

params.name: PLAYBACK_ID
params.description: The asset or live stream's playback ID.

params.name: EXTENSION
params.description: The image file extension, either 'gif' or 'webp'.

params.name: start
params.description: The time (in seconds) of the video timeline where the animated GIF should begin. Defaults to 0.

params.name: end
params.description: The time (in seconds) of the video timeline where the GIF ends. Defaults to 5 seconds after the start. Maximum total duration of GIF is limited to 10 seconds; minimum total duration of GIF is 250ms.

params.name: width
params.description: The width in pixels of the animated GIF. Default is 320px, or if height is provided, the width is determined by preserving aspect ratio with the height. Max width is 640px.

params.name: height
params.description: The height in pixels of the animated GIF. The default height is determined by preserving aspect ratio with the width provided. Maximum height is 640px.

params.name: fps
params.description: The frame rate of the generated GIF. Defaults to 15 fps. Max 30 fps.

items.docs: [Fetch an animated GIF or WebP image](https://docs.mux.com/guides/get-images-from-a-video#get-an-animated-gif-from-a-video) from a video segment with optional transformations.
